files.revenue.sql:
SELECT p.name,
       SUM(o.qty)                        AS units,
       ROUND(SUM(o.qty * p.price), 2)    AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
